role.altitude: The industrial engineering technician keeps measuring, drawing layouts, observing work, finding better methods and coaching colleagues; typing parts lists, transcribing stopwatch sheets and pulling cost data into spreadsheets shrink.
skills_to_grow: Keeping CAD libraries and cost models current
Running time studies the works council trusts
role.ambitious_version: A technician who prices a layout change the same day it is drawn.

tasks.short: Measure the floor and equipment, prepare layouts, drawings or sketches of machinery or equipment in CAD software, produce the parts list and review the layout with the engineer and production.

steps.what: Industrial engineering technician measures the floor space and equipment on site
Industrial engineering technician prepares layouts and drawings of machinery and equipment in CAD software
Industrial engineering technician produces the parts list for the layout
Industrial engineering technician reviews the layout with the engineer and production and revises it

tasks.design: The CAD library holds blocks of the plant's standard machines, racks and tooling with their attributes, so layouts are assembled from blocks rather than drawn line by line. The parts list is generated from the block attributes in the drawing instead of typed. Measuring, drawing choices and the review stay with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Parts lists were counted off drawings and typed into spreadsheets.
tasks.enabler_now: CAD block libraries with attributes and generated parts lists.
tasks.still_hard: Fitting new equipment into old buildings.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing how operators will actually walk the layout.
tasks.altitude: Less counting and redrawing; layout judgement stays.

reach.learn: Whether generated parts lists cut order errors.

evidence.claim: Design software generates reports, wire lists and bills of materials from the model.
Harness design software gave 25% shorter lead time in a vendor case, without a stated method.

assumptions: Boundary: preparing a layout and its parts list; installation is outside.
Input contract for s3: block attributes for standard equipment kept in the CAD library by the technicians; about 80% of items are standard blocks; s3 is priced at that share.
Measuring and review keep their full time.

incremental.description: Industrial engineering technician keeps CAD blocks and attributes current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: one-off special equipment; high: repeated layouts of standard lines.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan a study and inform workers, study time, motion and methods of operations by observing and timing them, compute the standard production rate and analyse methods to improve efficiency.

steps.what: Industrial engineering technician plans the study and informs the workers involved
Industrial engineering technician observes and times operations by element
Industrial engineering technician transcribes timings and computes the standard production rate
Industrial engineering technician analyses methods and proposes ways to improve efficiency

tasks.design: The technician times elements on a tablet stopwatch app that stores times per element, and machine-paced elements take their cycle times from the machines' own logs instead of the stopwatch. Ratings, allowances and the standard rate are computed by fixed formulas from the stored times. Observing manual work, rating and finding better methods stay with the technician. Studies follow the scheme agreed with the works council, and results set standards for operations, not ratings of individuals.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stopwatch readings were written on paper and typed into spreadsheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Time study apps and machine cycle-time logs.
tasks.still_hard: Rating the pace of manual work fairly.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing a better way to do the job while watching it.
tasks.altitude: Less transcribing; observation and method work stay.

reach.learn: Whether transparent formulas build trust in standards.

evidence.claim: Standard times are fixed formulas over observed times, ratings and allowances.
Assigning work by worker performance is an AI Act high-risk use.
Systems fit to monitor staff performance need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: one time and methods study; changing the line is outside.
Input contract for s2: machine cycle-time logs from the line's controllers for machine-paced elements, about 30% of elements; manual elements are timed in person.
Input contract for s3: element times stored by the app during s2.
Planning and method analysis keep their full time.
unknowns: Whether the works council has agreed a time study scheme.

incremental.description: Industrial engineering technician explains the formulas to the works council.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: mostly manual operations; high: machine-paced lines with cycle-time logs.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide advice to other technicians on the floor, prepare training material and work instructions, give training and record who was trained.

steps.what: Industrial engineering technician provides advice to other technicians on the floor
Industrial engineering technician prepares training material and work instructions
Industrial engineering technician gives training to other technicians
Industrial engineering technician records who was trained

tasks.design: Work instructions use a standard template with photos taken on the line, kept in the document system so they are updated rather than rewritten. Trainees sign in on a tablet at the session, which records attendance in the training register instead of a spreadsheet. Advice and training stay face to face.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instructions were rewritten per session and attendance kept on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Instruction templates and training registers with tablet sign-in.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining tacit skills that are not in any instruction.
tasks.human_edge: Showing a colleague the trick that makes the job easy.

evidence.claim: Records apps with notifications replace spreadsheets for logs and schedules.

assumptions: Boundary: advising and training colleagues; certification is outside.
Input contract for s4: trainees signing in on the tablet at each session.
Advice and training keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of training that is informal.

incremental.description: Industrial engineering technician updates instructions when methods change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: mostly ad-hoc advice; high: frequent formal training sessions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Gather material, labour and machine data, analyze and estimate production costs, examine variances and report production costs to engineering and the controller.

steps.what: Industrial engineering technician gathers material, labour and machine data from the ERP
Industrial engineering technician estimates production costs in a spreadsheet
Industrial engineering technician analyzes variances and assumptions
Industrial engineering technician writes the cost report for engineering and the controller

tasks.design: A cost model reads bills of materials, routings, purchase prices and machine and labour rates straight from the ERP and computes the estimate, instead of exports pasted into a spreadsheet. The report template fills tables and charts from the cost model, and the technician writes the analysis of variances and conclusions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cost data were exported from the ERP and rebuilt in a spreadsheet per question.
tasks.enabler_now: Cost models reading ERP master data.
tasks.still_hard: Costs of new parts with no price yet.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which assumption drives the cost.

reach.learn: Whether estimates and actual costs converge.

evidence.claim: Quantities, bills of materials and costs are deterministic from the model and price tables.
Design software generates bills of materials from the model.

assumptions: Boundary: estimating and reporting production costs; setting prices is outside.

Input contract for s1: bills of materials and routings kept in the ERP by engineering, purchase prices by purchasing and rates by the controller; about 80% of parts have current prices; s1 is priced at that share.
Variance analysis keeps its full time.
unknowns: How current routings and prices are in the ERP.
research_questions: Do estimates get closer to actual costs?

already_counted.description: Industrial engineering technician checks parts flagged for missing or old prices.

incremental.description: Industrial engineering technician maintains the cost model.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: new products with missing prices; high: routine cost updates for existing products.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
